description: Procurement of vaccines for the National Immunization Programme of Sri Lanka through the UNICEF Global Supply Division
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Immunization Programme of Sri Lanka is working to ensure the availability of high-quality vaccines at affordable prices in line with the World Health Organization’s Expanded programme on Immunization. The programme offers vaccines to approximately 1.5 million children and 300,000 pregnant women annually to prevent 11 diseases. The Global Alliance for Vaccines and Immunization has been providing support for the procurement of these vaccines since 2000. Also, the said Alliance has provided financial support to procure vaccines through the Global Supply Division of UNICEF from 2023 to 2025 through a joint procurement method. Unlike a procurement process carried out by an individual country, it is possible to procure WHO recommended and prequalified vaccines through the Global Supply Division of UNICEF at lower prices, ensuring a greater security of supply. Further, it paves the way for the continuous supply of vaccines, timely distribution of vaccines, and effective procurement practices. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to procure Immunization vaccines for the National Immunization Programme of Sri Lanka through Global Supply Division of UNICEF for the period 2026-2030, was approved by the Cabinet.
